description: This file defines the EntityFormDisplayEditForm class, a Drupal form class for editing entity form display configurations, including methods for building form rows, retrieving display modes, and managing third-party settings.

classes.name: EntityFormDisplayEditForm
classes.description: A Drupal form class for editing entity form display configurations, extending EntityDisplayFormBase and implementing methods for form building and display management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the form with necessary services from the container.

methods.name: buildFieldRow
methods.description: Builds a form row for a specific field, updating plugin formatter labels and settings.

methods.name: getEntityDisplay
methods.description: Retrieves the form display configuration for a given entity type, bundle, and mode.

methods.name: getDefaultPlugin
methods.description: Returns the default widget plugin for a given field type.

methods.name: getDisplayModes
methods.description: Gets available form display modes for the target entity type.

methods.name: getDisplayModeOptions
methods.description: Gets options for form display modes for the target entity type.

methods.name: getDisplayModesLink
methods.description: Provides a link to manage form modes.

methods.name: getTableHeader
methods.description: Defines the table header for the form display overview.

methods.name: getOverviewUrl
methods.description: Generates URL to the form display overview page for a specific mode.

methods.name: thirdPartySettingsForm
methods.description: Builds a form for third-party plugin settings, invoking relevant hooks.

methods.name: alterSettingsSummary
methods.description: Allows alteration of the settings summary for a widget plugin.
